verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll docs describe employee onboarding flows (company, employee, contractor onboarding UI Flows), required federal/state tax setup for employees, and a payroll/tax platform overview, plus an official MCP server letting AI agents interact directly with the Embedded Payroll API — supporting agent-driven onboarding. However, there is no explicit doc snippet showing a full API-only sequence for creating an employee object, setting compensation, and tax setup end-to-end (much of the emphasized onboarding path uses pre-built UI Flows rather than raw API calls). missing for 10: explicit employee-creation and compensation-setup API endpoint examples, and an end-to-end code walkthrough showing an agent driving the full sequence purely via API without UI Flows.
